rows.grounds: indeclinable adverbial compound expressing manifold manners or modes
instrumental plural denoting the diverse forms or appearances of existence
present participle fused with emphatic particle; affirms sole existence
subject identified as the highest lord, the sole reality

items.question: How can the supreme lord alone constitute reality amid manifold forms of being?
premises: An unreal factor cannot establish real causal agency.
Relation with an unreal factor cannot be coherently maintained.
Manifold forms of being appear in various ways.
items.inference: Therefore, the supreme lord alone truly exists as the reality underlying all manifold forms of being.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of tathātathā as specific modes versus general multiplicity is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: In various ways, through manifold forms of being, the supreme lord alone truly exists.
